Entities / Places / Port Tidefall

Port Tidefall

Overview

Port Tidefall is carved directly into the cliff face of Calder’s Tooth in three tiers: Dockfront at the waterline, the Shelf mid-cliff, and Fort Crestwall at the crown with cannon pointed seaward. The harbour mouth is narrow, the inspection pier extends to starboard before any ship reaches the dock, and three nooses hang from the gate arch above the entrance — empty, freshly painted black. Nobody in port remembers when they went up.

Every ship entering the western Strait is expected to stop, answer questions, and produce the right paper in the right order. Most do.

Districts

The Dockfront — At the waterline, where arrival becomes procedure. The Inspection Pier catches ships before the docks proper; the Harbourmaster’s Office converts the delay into ratings, fees, and official charts.

The Shelf — Mid-cliff commercial district. Trade licensing, navigational instruments, Crown petitions, officer business, and side deals all pass through here.

Fort Crestwall — Pass-only. Barracks, command post, armoury, court, and cannon battery above the harbour approach.

Current Hooks

  • The garrison has been running heavy for several weeks, and people who should know why are finding out that they do not.
DM Note

Two extra companies arrived at Fort Crestwall under Admiralty-sealed orders Governor Voss was never given. Supply manifest includes reef-diving equipment and underwater charges bound for the Drowned Maw. See Governor’s Seat — DM Notes.
